name: Hyrkanian & Tushara Rail-Khanates
notes: Wind-hardened overland empire of the northern passes. Camelosuchus riders, armored trains, and a monopoly on coal and iron. Nomadic-industrial empire of the northern passes and the Hyrcanian steppe. Its riders sit domesticated Camelosuchus; its armoured steam-and-diesel trains run the Trans-Himalayan corridors, and it holds the overland coal, iron and trade routes into the Saraswati Basin. A nation of the Age of Machinery, on the pre-Shattering chart.
